title: Screen reader
summary: For every JSXGraph element, all [ARIA attributes](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA) can be set. In this example, a [screen reader](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Screen_reader) will read the coordinates of *point A* when the point has the focus. The focus can be set with the key or with mouse click. The point may be moved by mouse, pen, finger, or arrow keys.
